name: Grotta Christmas Village 2026
description: Grotta Christmas Village is a festive destination experience at Grotta Resort in Musanze, bringing together Christmas lights, seasonal food, live entertainment, family activities, cinema, crafts, photo moments, the Mini Farm and Bunny Village, swimming, sports and festive accommodation.
sourceNote: Master Plan v3.1 and Website FAQ v3, 30 September 2026

highDemand.note: The Village remains open on these dates. Higher attendance is expected, so plan ahead and arrive early.

ticket.appliesTo: Adults and children alike — there is no reduced child or infant price.

residents.text: Guests staying at Grotta Resort receive complimentary access to the Christmas Village. Consumable credit is not included automatically — residents load or top up their QR wristband before purchasing food, drinks, products or paid activities.

contact.pendingText: Official contact details, directions and the Village booking link will be published here once approved.
